name: Sugar No. 11
read: Sugar No. 11 Mar 27 options (on MAR 27 futures 18.1, 92 days to expiry 2027-02-16): at-the-money implied vol 25.8%, +0.8 pts vs 2026-11-10. 20-day realized vol 29.1%, so options trade at a discount of 3.3 pts. 25-delta risk reversal +4.8 (calls over puts). Over the last 10 sessions (2026-11-03 to 2026-11-16) call open interest rose 11,018 and puts fell 18,632; put/call OI 0.52 → 0.48, front futures 18.33 → 18.1. Delta-weighted, option holders added about +7,644 futures-equivalent lots in the last 5 sessions (net long exposure bought through options). Front ATM vol 25.3% → 24.8%. Largest Mar 27 strikes: 20 calls (26,937 lots) and 17 puts (17,381). Biggest 5-session builds: Mar 27 20 calls +3,406; Mar 27 22 calls +2,222. Biggest cut: Mar 27 17 puts -1,441.
